name: WSF_RPJ_EFFECT
description: Specifies the ratio of pulses that are coherently processed by the victim’s receiver. Divides the power between the coherent and noise jammer power by this ratio.

subCommands.name: coherency_ratio
subCommands.description: Specifies the ratio of pulses that are coherently processed by the victim’s receiver. Divides the power between the coherent and noise jammer power by this ratio.

subCommands.name: jamming_pulse_density
subCommands.description: Specifies the pulse density of the jamming signal in range [0,1] to use for this radar type.

subCommands.name: samples_per_detection
subCommands.description: Specifies the number of pulse samples used in a single detection attempt for a target (e.g., number of Fast Fourier Transform, Integration bins used by the radar). Must be greater than 1.

subCommands.name: minimum_jammer_to_noise_threshold
subCommands.description: Specifies the minimum jammer-to-noise ratio that this effect is able to effect this radar type’s receiver.

subCommands.name: jammer_gain_table
subCommands.description: This block defines the jammer gain this effect exhibits as a function of the jammer-to-noise ratio and the pulse density present (i.e., achieved from the input jammer pulse density) in the victim’s receiver.

subCommands.name: jammer_to_noise_ratio
subCommands.description: Specifies the jammer-to-noise ratio the following set of pulse_density_to_jamming_gain is valid for. This input can be repeated for multiple jammer-to-signal input values as required.

subCommands.name: pulse_density_to_jamming_gain
subCommands.description: Specifies the jammer power gain factor on the receiver for the achieved pulse density at the victim receiver. This input can be repeated for multiple pulse_density_to_jamming_gain input values for a given jammer_to_noise_ratio as required. Pulse density input range [0.0,…1.0]. The gain lookup values are interpolated for pulse density’s that fall between two values in the table. A pulse_density of 0.0 is automatically mapped to a jammer_gain of -300.0 dB in the tables but can be overridden by the input.

subCommands.name: system_type_data
subCommands.description: Input block to provide the system type (e.g., SENSOR-TYPE, JAMMER-TYPE) specific data necessary to implement this technique for a given system type. Default data can be set up for system types not defined using the “default” string as the system type.

name: WSF_SA_PROCESSOR
description: Specifies the update interval for reporting asset status data

subCommands.name: report_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting asset status data

subCommands.name: engagement_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting engagement data (MsgSA_EngagementSummaryData messages)

subCommands.name: flight_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting flight data (MsgSA_FlightKinematicsData messages)

subCommands.name: fuel_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting fuel data (MsgSA_FuelData messages)

subCommands.name: nav_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting navigational data (MsgSA_NavData messages)

subCommands.name: flight_controls_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting controls data (MsgSA_FlightControlsData messages)

subCommands.name: weapons_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting weapons data (MsgSA_WeaponsData messages)

subCommands.name: track_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting track data (MsgSA_TrackData messages)

subCommands.name: asset_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting asset data (MsgSA_PerceivedAssetsData messages)

subCommands.name: asset_purge_lifetime
subCommands.description: Specifies the maximum lifetime of assets that lack an update. Assets will be automatically purged if they have not been updated within the specified lifetime limit.

subCommands.name: perceived_item_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting bogie, bandit, and group data (MsgSA_PerceivedBogiesAndBanditsData and MsgSA_GroupsData messages).

subCommands.name: prioritized_item_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting prioritized threat data (MsgSA_PrioritizedThreatsAndTargetsData messages).

subCommands.name: perceived_item_calculation_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for calculating bogie, bandit, and group data.

subCommands.name: prioritized_item_calculation_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for calculating prioritized threat data.

subCommands.name: behavior_calculation_update_interval
subCommands.description: The SA Processor is unique in that the rate at which WsfAdvancedBehaviorTrees and WsfStateMachines update can be optionally set separately from the processor’s update rate. As a result, the default value of 0 means that it will update at the same rate as the processor, as opposed to never updating.

subCommands.name: cognitive_update_interval
subCommands.description: The following group of Update Interval Commands is set to a common value by this command:

subCommands.name: platform_update_interval
subCommands.description: The following group of Update Interval Commands is set to a common value by this command:

subCommands.name: universal_update_interval
subCommands.description: All Update Interval Commands are set to a common value by this command (excludes asset_purge_lifetime and all calculation update interval commands).

subCommands.name: enemy_side
subCommands.description: Specifies the name(s) of the enemy’s side(s). If a track has the same side identification as the enemy_side, then the track is considered to be a bandit. Note that multiple entries allows multiple sides to be enemy.

subCommands.name: friendly_side
subCommands.description: Specifies the name(s) of the friendly side(s). If a track has the same side identification as the friendly_side, then the track is considered to be a friendly. Note that multiple entries allows multiple sides to be friendly. In addition, the same side of the platform containing the SA Processor is always considered friendly, even without specifying it in this manner.

subCommands.name: neutral_side
subCommands.description: Specifies the name(s) of the neutral side(s). If a track has the same side identification as the neutral_side, then the track is considered to be a neutral. Note that multiple entries allows multiple sides to be neutral.

subCommands.name: enemy_type
subCommands.description: Adds the enemy type to the list of known enemy types. If a track has the same type identification as the enemy_type, then the track is considered to be a bandit. Note that the type does not necessarily have to be a platform type, it may also be a sensor type, since some sensors will report a sensor type rather than a platform type.

subCommands.name: friendly_type
subCommands.description: Adds the friendly type to the list of known friendly types. If a track has the same type identification as the friendly_type, then the track is considered to be friendly. Note that the type does not necessarily have to be a platform type, it may also be a sensor type, since some sensors will report a sensor type rather than a platform type.

subCommands.name: neutral_type
subCommands.description: Adds the neutral type to the list of known neutral types. If a track has the same type identification as the neutral_type, then the track is considered to be neutral. Note that the type does not necessarily have to be a platform type, it may also be a sensor type, since some sensors will report a sensor type rather than a platform type.

subCommands.name: missile_type
subCommands.description: Adds the missile type to the list of known missile types. If a track has the same type identification as the missile_type, then the track is considered to be a missile. Note that the type does not necessarily have to be a platform type, it may also be a sensor type, since some sensors will report a sensor type rather than a platform type.

subCommands.name: asset_ignore
subCommands.description: Adds the platform category to a list of assets that will be ignored on the ACES Display.

subCommands.name: filter_assets_from_tracks
subCommands.description: If true, assets/friendlies will be filtered from track lists

subCommands.name: use_iff_id
subCommands.description: If true, includes the use of IFF in determining identification. When used, iff_mapping must be defined.

subCommands.name: use_simple_id_by_type
subCommands.description: If true, a simple identification-by-type approach will be used. In this case, rather than specifying list of enemy, friendly, and neutral types using enemy_side, friendly_side, and neutral_side, a much simpler approach is used, where identification-by-type is performed merely if the track supports type id.

subCommands.name: missile_speed_any_alt
subCommands.description: If the speed of the track is greater than the specified speed and at any altitude, it will be considered to be a missile/weapon (not an aircraft).

subCommands.name: missile_alt_any_speed
subCommands.description: If the altitude of the track is greater than the specified altitude and at any speed, it will be considered to be a missile/weapon (not an aircraft).

subCommands.name: missile_speed_with_alt
subCommands.description: If the speed of the track is greater than the specified speed at (or greater than) the altitude specified in missile_alt_with_speed, it will be considered to be a missile/weapon (not an aircraft).

subCommands.name: missile_alt_with_speed
subCommands.description: If the altitude of the track is greater than the specified altitude at (or greater than) the speed specified in missile_speed_with_alt, it will be considered to be a missile/weapon (not an aircraft).

subCommands.name: missile_nose_angle
subCommands.description: If the ownship lies outside of the specified angle off the nose of the track, it will not be considered to be a missile/weapon (not an aircraft). This allows filtering-out tracks that are not heading towards the ownship.

subCommands.name: missile_time_to_intercept
subCommands.description: If the time to intercept of the track is greater than than the specified time, it will not be considered to be a missile/weapon (not an aircraft). This allows filtering-out tracks that will not intercept the ownship within the specified time.

subCommands.name: missile_distance
subCommands.description: If the distance to the track is greater than the specified distance, it will not be considered to be a missile/weapon (not an aircraft). This allows filtering-out tracks at a long distance from being considered as missiles.

subCommands.name: max_range_for_perceived_assets
subCommands.description: Range limit to include an asset in the perceived asset list. If not specified, no range filter will be used for assets.

subCommands.name: max_range_for_perceived_bogies_and_bandits
subCommands.description: Range limit to include a bogie/bandit in the perceived bogie/bandit list. If not specified, no range filter will be used for bogies or bandits.

subCommands.name: max_range_for_engagement_data
subCommands.description: Range limit to report engagement data. If not specified, no range filter will be used on the reporting of engagement data.

subCommands.name: assumed_range_for_angle_only_targets
subCommands.description: Range assumed for angle-only tracks. If not specified, the range for angle-only tracks will be assumed to be 2.0E+13 meters, which is greater than 100 times the distance from the Earth to the Sun.

subCommands.name: filter_requires_same_side
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that are not on the same side

subCommands.name: filter_requires_not_same_side
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that are on the same side

subCommands.name: filter_requires_air_domain
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that are not in the air domain

subCommands.name: filter_requires_not_air_domain
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that are in the air domain

subCommands.name: filter_requires_land_or_surface_domain
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that are not in the land or surface domains

subCommands.name: filter_requires_not_subsurface_domain
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that are in the subsurface domain

subCommands.name: filter_requires_not_space_domain
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that are in the space domain

subCommands.name: filter_requires_sa_processor
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that lack a WSF_SA_PROCESSOR

subCommands.name: esm_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for ESM/RWR tracks. This allows perception of tracks related to ESM and/or RWR sensor systems.

subCommands.name: mws_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for Missile Warning System (MWS) tracks. This allows perception of tracks related to MWS sensor systems.

subCommands.name: radar_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for radar tracks. This allows perception of tracks related to radar sensor systems.

subCommands.name: irst_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for IRST tracks. This allows perception of tracks related to IRST and/or other IR sensors used for detection of airborne platforms.

subCommands.name: das_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for DAS (Distributed Aperture System) tracks. This allows perception of tracks related to DAS and/or other multi-aperture IR/EO sensor systems.

subCommands.name: flir_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for FLIR tracks. This allows perception of tracks related to FLIRs and/or other imaging IR sensor systems that are primarily used for detection of surface-based platforms.

subCommands.name: eyes_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for eyes (visual) tracks. This allows perception of tracks related to any aircrew visual (eyes) sightings.

subCommands.name: perception_master_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for collecting/coordinating perceived tracks. If this is defined, the specified track processor will be used by the SA Processor when perceiving and assessing tracks. If not specified, the master track processor is used (default).

subCommands.name: flight_id
subCommands.description: Optional flight id (used to denote aircraft in a particular flight). A value of zero indicates that the aircraft is not a member of any flight.

subCommands.name: id_flag
subCommands.description: Optional string that provides an id within a flight.

subCommands.name: bingo_fuel
subCommands.description: Optional bingo fuel level. If not specified, the mover value is used (if available), else zero is used.

subCommands.name: joker_fuel
subCommands.description: Optional joker fuel level. If not specified, the mover value is used (if available), else zero is used.

subCommands.name: reporting_self
subCommands.description: Specifies whether or not to report out asset status messages about this platform.

subCommands.name: reporting_others
subCommands.description: Specifies whether or not to report out messages of all received and known asset status (of other platforms).

subCommands.name: asset_perception
subCommands.description: status_messages: asset perception will utilize any received WsfSA_EntityMessage messages.

subCommands.name: perceive_self
subCommands.description: Include this platform in the list of perceived assets.

subCommands.name: max_threat_load
subCommands.description: Specifies the maximum number of bogie/bandit entities and unfocused groups (i.e. perceived items) that may be perceived.

subCommands.name: max_asset_load
subCommands.description: Specifies the maximum number of assets that may be perceived.

subCommands.name: asset_coast_time
subCommands.description: Specifies the amount of time that asset perceptions should persist after losing a track.

subCommands.name: bandit_coast_time
subCommands.description: Specifies the amount of time that bandit perceptions should persist after losing a track.

subCommands.name: bogey_coast_time
subCommands.description: Specifies the amount of time that bogey perceptions should persist after losing a track.

subCommands.name: use_simple_countermeasures
subCommands.description: If true, the processor will use num_chaff, num_flares, and num_decoys as the initial countermeasure quantities. When WsfSA_Processor.DispenseChaff, WsfSA_Processor.DispenseFlare, and WsfSA_Processor.DispenseDecoy are invoked, these quantities are simply decremented (nothing is physically fired). If false, the processor will model countermeasures using instances of WSF_CHAFF_WEAPON, WSF_FLARE_WEAPON, and WSF_DECOY_WEAPON defined on the parent platform. When WsfSA_Processor.DispenseChaff, WsfSA_Processor.DispenseFlare, and WsfSA_Processor.DispenseDecoy are called, the respective countermeasures are fired.

subCommands.name: num_chaff
subCommands.description: When used together with use_simple_countermeasures, specifies the initial chaff quantity.

subCommands.name: num_flares
subCommands.description: When used together with use_simple_countermeasures, specifies the initial flare quantity.

subCommands.name: num_decoys
subCommands.description: When used together with use_simple_countermeasures, specifies the initial decoy quantity.

subCommands.name: filter_assets_from_bogies
subCommands.description: If true, known assets will automatically be filtered from bogies.

subCommands.name: consideration_score_randomness
subCommands.description: If set, the consideration scores for perceived items will be randomly increased or decreased by an amount less than or equal to this value.

subCommands.name: display_perception_delay
subCommands.description: Specifies the time to wait before recognizing a new non-visual track as a perceived entity that is available for processing and classification.

subCommands.name: visual_perception_delay
subCommands.description: Specifies the time to wait before recognizing a new visual track (i.e. eyes_track_processor) as a perceived entity that is available for processing and classification.

subCommands.name: bogie_threat_score_multiplier
subCommands.description: Multiplier that is used when scoring bogies for the prioritized threat list.

subCommands.name: bogie_target_score_multiplier
subCommands.description: Multiplier that is used when scoring bogies for the prioritized target list.

subCommands.name: ignore_bogies_when_grouping
subCommands.description: If true, bogies will not be considered when forming groups.

subCommands.name: mission_task
subCommands.description: Specifies the primary mission task. This is used in Air Combat Event Pipe data and for display purposes in the Air Combat Visualization Plugin’s Air Combat Overlays.

subCommands.name: max_prioritized_threats
subCommands.description: Specifies limitation to prioritized threat list count.

subCommands.name: max_prioritized_targets
subCommands.description: Specifies limitation to prioritized target list count.

subCommands.name: max_grouping_distance_centroid
subCommands.description: If use_centroid_grouping is true, the maximum distance an entity can be from a group centroid to be considered part of the group.

subCommands.name: max_grouping_distance_neighbor
subCommands.description: If use_neighbor_grouping is true, the maximum distance an entity can be from another entity in a group to be considered part of the same group.

subCommands.name: max_grouping_speed_difference
subCommands.description: If use_speed_grouping is true, the maximum difference in speed an entity can be from a group centroid to be considered part of the group.

subCommands.name: max_grouping_heading_difference
subCommands.description: If use_neighbor_grouping is true, the maximum difference in heading an entity can be from a group centroid to be considered part of the group.

subCommands.name: min_group_radius
subCommands.description: The minimum radius for a group. The group radius is the maximum of the min_group_radius and the largest distance between a group member and the group centroid.

subCommands.name: use_centroid_grouping
subCommands.description: Specifies whether an entity must be within max_grouping_distance_centroid of the group centroid to be considered part of the group.

subCommands.name: use_neighbor_grouping
subCommands.description: Specifies whether an entity must be within max_grouping_distance_neighbor of another entity in a group to be considered part of that group.

subCommands.name: use_speed_grouping
subCommands.description: Specifies whether an entity must be within max_grouping_speed_difference of the group centroid to be considered part of the group. This only applies when entities are considered for joining a group, not for continuing to stay in the group.

subCommands.name: use_heading_grouping
subCommands.description: Specifies whether an entity must be within max_grouping_heading_difference of the group centroid to be considered part of the group. This only applies when entities are considered for joining a group, not for continuing to stay in the group.

subCommands.name: use_type_grouping
subCommands.description: Specifies whether an entity must be the same type as the other members of a group to be considered part of the group. This only applies when entities are considered for joining a group, not for continuing to stay in the group.

subCommands.name: ignore_missiles_as_threats
subCommands.description: Specifies whether perceived missile entities should be ignored when calculating threat values. Typically, perceived missiles are considered threats and are not ignored.

subCommands.name: ignore_bogies_as_threats
subCommands.description: Specifies whether perceived bogie entities should be ignored when calculating threat values. Typically, perceived bogies are considered threats and are not ignored.

subCommands.name: ignore_missiles_as_targets
subCommands.description: Specifies whether perceived missile entities should be ignored when calculating target values. Typically, perceived missiles are not considered targets and are ignored.

subCommands.name: ignore_bogies_as_targets
subCommands.description: Specifies whether perceived bogie entities should be ignored when calculating target values. Typically, perceived bogies are not considered targets and are ignored.

subCommands.name: missile_wez_parameters
subCommands.description: Defines parameters for WEZ calculations. See missile_wez_parameters.

subCommands.name: aircraft_signature_parameters
subCommands.description: Defines parameters for aircraft signatures. See aircraft_signature_parameters.

subCommands.name: AssetConsiderationScoring
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to measure asset importance, which is used to determine how strongly the asset should be considered for maintaining perception. If this function is present, it completely overrides the use of any script functions that try to set asset importance or unimportance. This is only useful when max_asset_load is defined, otherwise no limit will be imposed and importance is not necessary. Values returned by the script may be any value (positive or negative), but assets presenting negative scores will be discarded from consideration. High scores indicate a greater interest in the asset, as compared to others.

subCommands.name: BogieBanditConsiderationScoring
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to measure bogie/bandit importance, which is used to determine how strongly the bogie/bandit should be considered for maintaining perception. If this function is present, it completely overrides the use of any script functions that try to set bogie/bandit importance or unimportance. This is only useful when max_threat_load is defined, otherwise no limit will be imposed and importance is not necessary. Values returned by the script may be any value (positive or negative), but bogies/bandits presenting negative scores will be discarded from consideration. High scores indicate a greater interest in the bogie/bandit, as compared to others.

subCommands.name: MissileConsiderationScoring
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to measure perceived missile bogie/bandit importance, which is used to determine how strongly the missile bogie/bandit should be considered for maintaining perception. If this function is present, it completely overrides the use of any script functions that try to set missile bogie/bandit importance or unimportance. This is only useful when max_threat_load is defined, otherwise no limit will be imposed and importance is not necessary. Values returned by the script may be any value (positive or negative), but missile bogies/bandits presenting negative scores will be discarded from consideration. High scores indicate a greater interest in the missile bogie/bandit, as compared to others.

subCommands.name: UnfocusedGroupConsiderationScoring
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to measure perceived unfocused group importance, which is used to determine how strongly the group should be considered for maintaining perception. If this function is present, it completely overrides the use of any script functions that try to set bogie/bandit importance or unimportance. This is only useful when max_threat_load is defined, otherwise no limit will be imposed and importance is not necessary. Values returned by the script may be any value (positive or negative), but bogies/bandits presenting negative scores will be discarded from consideration. High scores indicate a greater interest in the bogie/bandit, as compared to others.

subCommands.name: CreatePerceivedItemPruningArray
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to override the default behavior to keep the number of perceived items within max_threat_load.

subCommands.name: CalculateRisk
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the overall operational/tactical risk as assessed by the WSF_SA_PROCESSOR. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateSelfRisk
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the operational/tactical “self-risk” as assessed by the WSF_SA_PROCESSOR, considering only the risk faced by this platform. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateFlightRisk
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the operational/tactical “flight risk” as assessed by the WSF_SA_PROCESSOR, considering the risk that the flight of aircraft (often two or four aircraft) is facing. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculatePackageRisk
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the operational/tactical “package risk” as assessed by the WSF_SA_PROCESSOR, considering the risk that the package of aircraft (often multiple flights of aircraft) is facing. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateMissionRisk
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the operational/tactical “mission risk” as assessed by the WSF_SA_PROCESSOR, considering the risk(s) that might prevent the success of the current mission. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateDefensiveness
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the degree of defensiveness that the platform has assessed for the current operational/tactical situation as assessed by the WSF_SA_PROCESSOR. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateUrgency
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the sense of urgency imposed by the operational/tactical situation as assessed by the WSF_SA_PROCESSOR. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateWeaponSupport
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate if a weapon is being supported (i.e., is being provided track update information by the parent platform). If a weapon is being supported, it should return true. There is no default implementation for weapon support, so if this function is omitted, the weapon support condition will always be false.

subCommands.name: CalculateThreatLevel
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the threat level presented by the specified bogie/bandit (aThreat). The boolean (aIsBogie) should be true if the threat is a bogie and false if the threat is a bandit. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateMissileThreatLevel
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the threat level presented by the specified missile bogie/bandit (aThreat). The boolean (aIsBogie) should be true if the threat is a bogie and false if the threat is a bandit. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation. This is used with CalculateThreatLevel, where CalculateMissileThreatLevel is used for perceived missiles, while CalculateThreatLevel is used for aircraft (and even missiles that are not yet perceived as missiles).

subCommands.name: CalculateGroupThreatLevel
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the threat level presented by the specified unfocused group of bogies/bandits (aThreat). The boolean (aIsBogie) should be true if the threat is a bogie and false if the threat is a bandit. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation. This is used with CalculateThreatLevel, where CalculateGroupThreatLevel is used for perceived unfocused groups, while CalculateThreatLevel is used for aircraft (and even missiles that are not yet perceived as missiles).

subCommands.name: CalculateTargetValue
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the target value offered by the specified bogie/bandit (aTarget). The boolean (aIsBogie) should be true if the target is a bogie and false if the target is a bandit. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateMissileTargetValue
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the target value offered by the specified missile bogie/bandit (aTarget). The boolean (aIsBogie) should be true if the target is a bogie and false if the target is a bandit. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation. This is used with CalculateTargetValue, where CalculateMissileTargetValue is used for perceived missiles, while CalculateTargetValue is used for aircraft (and even missiles that are not yet perceived as missiles).

subCommands.name: CalculateGroupTargetValue
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the target value offered by the specified unfocused group of bogies/bandits (aTarget). The boolean (aIsBogie) should be true if the target is a bogie and false if the target is a bandit. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation. This is used with CalculateTargetValue, where CalculateGroupTargetValue is used for unfocused groups, while CalculateTargetValue is used for aircraft (and even missiles that are not yet perceived as missiles).

subCommands.name: CalculateRiskPosedByEntity
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the risk posed by the specified bogie/bandit entity. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateDefensivenessInducedByEntity
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the degree of defensiveness induced by the specified bogie/bandit entity. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateUrgencyInducedByEntity
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the sense of urgency induced by the specified bogie/bandit entity. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionInTime
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionForward
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming forward motion. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionLevelTurnLeft
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming it carries out a constant-g turn to its left. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionLevelTurnRight
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming it carries out a g-limited level turn to its right. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionTurnToHeading
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming it carries out a g-limited level turn to the provided heading. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionGoToPoint
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming it carries out a g-limited level turn toward the provided location. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionSlice
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming it carries out a g-limited roll-and-pull maneuver away from its current heading. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionSliceToHeading
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming it carries out a g-limited roll-and-pull maneuver to the provided heading. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionSplitS
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming it carries out a g-limited split-S maneuver. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: report_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting asset status data

subCommands.name: engagement_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting engagement data (MsgSA_EngagementSummaryData messages)

subCommands.name: flight_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting flight data (MsgSA_FlightKinematicsData messages)

subCommands.name: fuel_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting fuel data (MsgSA_FuelData messages)

subCommands.name: nav_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting navigational data (MsgSA_NavData messages)

subCommands.name: flight_controls_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting controls data (MsgSA_FlightControlsData messages)

subCommands.name: weapons_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting weapons data (MsgSA_WeaponsData messages)

subCommands.name: track_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting track data (MsgSA_TrackData messages)

subCommands.name: asset_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting asset data (MsgSA_PerceivedAssetsData messages)

subCommands.name: asset_purge_lifetime
subCommands.description: Specifies the maximum lifetime of assets that lack an update. Assets will be automatically purged if they have not been updated within the specified lifetime limit.

subCommands.name: perceived_item_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting bogie, bandit, and group data (MsgSA_PerceivedBogiesAndBanditsData and MsgSA_GroupsData messages).

subCommands.name: prioritized_item_data_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for reporting prioritized threat data (MsgSA_PrioritizedThreatsAndTargetsData messages).

subCommands.name: perceived_item_calculation_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for calculating bogie, bandit, and group data.

subCommands.name: prioritized_item_calculation_update_interval
subCommands.description: Specifies the update interval for calculating prioritized threat data.

subCommands.name: behavior_calculation_update_interval
subCommands.description: The SA Processor is unique in that the rate at which WsfAdvancedBehaviorTrees and WsfStateMachines update can be optionally set separately from the processor’s update rate. As a result, the default value of 0 means that it will update at the same rate as the processor, as opposed to never updating.

subCommands.name: cognitive_update_interval
subCommands.description: The following group of Update Interval Commands is set to a common value by this command:

subCommands.name: platform_update_interval
subCommands.description: The following group of Update Interval Commands is set to a common value by this command:

subCommands.name: universal_update_interval
subCommands.description: All Update Interval Commands are set to a common value by this command (excludes asset_purge_lifetime and all calculation update interval commands).

subCommands.name: enemy_side
subCommands.description: Specifies the name(s) of the enemy’s side(s). If a track has the same side identification as the enemy_side, then the track is considered to be a bandit. Note that multiple entries allows multiple sides to be enemy.

subCommands.name: friendly_side
subCommands.description: Specifies the name(s) of the friendly side(s). If a track has the same side identification as the friendly_side, then the track is considered to be a friendly. Note that multiple entries allows multiple sides to be friendly. In addition, the same side of the platform containing the SA Processor is always considered friendly, even without specifying it in this manner.

subCommands.name: neutral_side
subCommands.description: Specifies the name(s) of the neutral side(s). If a track has the same side identification as the neutral_side, then the track is considered to be a neutral. Note that multiple entries allows multiple sides to be neutral.

subCommands.name: enemy_type
subCommands.description: Adds the enemy type to the list of known enemy types. If a track has the same type identification as the enemy_type, then the track is considered to be a bandit. Note that the type does not necessarily have to be a platform type, it may also be a sensor type, since some sensors will report a sensor type rather than a platform type.

subCommands.name: friendly_type
subCommands.description: Adds the friendly type to the list of known friendly types. If a track has the same type identification as the friendly_type, then the track is considered to be friendly. Note that the type does not necessarily have to be a platform type, it may also be a sensor type, since some sensors will report a sensor type rather than a platform type.

subCommands.name: neutral_type
subCommands.description: Adds the neutral type to the list of known neutral types. If a track has the same type identification as the neutral_type, then the track is considered to be neutral. Note that the type does not necessarily have to be a platform type, it may also be a sensor type, since some sensors will report a sensor type rather than a platform type.

subCommands.name: missile_type
subCommands.description: Adds the missile type to the list of known missile types. If a track has the same type identification as the missile_type, then the track is considered to be a missile. Note that the type does not necessarily have to be a platform type, it may also be a sensor type, since some sensors will report a sensor type rather than a platform type.

subCommands.name: asset_ignore
subCommands.description: Adds the platform category to a list of assets that will be ignored on the ACES Display.

subCommands.name: filter_assets_from_tracks
subCommands.description: If true, assets/friendlies will be filtered from track lists

subCommands.name: use_iff_id
subCommands.description: If true, includes the use of IFF in determining identification. When used, iff_mapping must be defined.

subCommands.name: use_simple_id_by_type
subCommands.description: If true, a simple identification-by-type approach will be used. In this case, rather than specifying list of enemy, friendly, and neutral types using enemy_side, friendly_side, and neutral_side, a much simpler approach is used, where identification-by-type is performed merely if the track supports type id.

subCommands.name: missile_speed_any_alt
subCommands.description: If the speed of the track is greater than the specified speed and at any altitude, it will be considered to be a missile/weapon (not an aircraft).

subCommands.name: missile_alt_any_speed
subCommands.description: If the altitude of the track is greater than the specified altitude and at any speed, it will be considered to be a missile/weapon (not an aircraft).

subCommands.name: missile_speed_with_alt
subCommands.description: If the speed of the track is greater than the specified speed at (or greater than) the altitude specified in missile_alt_with_speed, it will be considered to be a missile/weapon (not an aircraft).

subCommands.name: missile_alt_with_speed
subCommands.description: If the altitude of the track is greater than the specified altitude at (or greater than) the speed specified in missile_speed_with_alt, it will be considered to be a missile/weapon (not an aircraft).

subCommands.name: missile_nose_angle
subCommands.description: If the ownship lies outside of the specified angle off the nose of the track, it will not be considered to be a missile/weapon (not an aircraft). This allows filtering-out tracks that are not heading towards the ownship.

subCommands.name: missile_time_to_intercept
subCommands.description: If the time to intercept of the track is greater than than the specified time, it will not be considered to be a missile/weapon (not an aircraft). This allows filtering-out tracks that will not intercept the ownship within the specified time.

subCommands.name: missile_distance
subCommands.description: If the distance to the track is greater than the specified distance, it will not be considered to be a missile/weapon (not an aircraft). This allows filtering-out tracks at a long distance from being considered as missiles.

subCommands.name: max_range_for_perceived_assets
subCommands.description: Range limit to include an asset in the perceived asset list. If not specified, no range filter will be used for assets.

subCommands.name: max_range_for_perceived_bogies_and_bandits
subCommands.description: Range limit to include a bogie/bandit in the perceived bogie/bandit list. If not specified, no range filter will be used for bogies or bandits.

subCommands.name: max_range_for_engagement_data
subCommands.description: Range limit to report engagement data. If not specified, no range filter will be used on the reporting of engagement data.

subCommands.name: assumed_range_for_angle_only_targets
subCommands.description: Range assumed for angle-only tracks. If not specified, the range for angle-only tracks will be assumed to be 2.0E+13 meters, which is greater than 100 times the distance from the Earth to the Sun.

subCommands.name: filter_requires_same_side
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that are not on the same side

subCommands.name: filter_requires_not_same_side
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that are on the same side

subCommands.name: filter_requires_air_domain
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that are not in the air domain

subCommands.name: filter_requires_not_air_domain
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that are in the air domain

subCommands.name: filter_requires_land_or_surface_domain
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that are not in the land or surface domains

subCommands.name: filter_requires_not_subsurface_domain
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that are in the subsurface domain

subCommands.name: filter_requires_not_space_domain
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that are in the space domain

subCommands.name: filter_requires_sa_processor
subCommands.description: If true, filters out platforms that lack a WSF_SA_PROCESSOR

subCommands.name: esm_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for ESM/RWR tracks. This allows perception of tracks related to ESM and/or RWR sensor systems.

subCommands.name: mws_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for Missile Warning System (MWS) tracks. This allows perception of tracks related to MWS sensor systems.

subCommands.name: radar_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for radar tracks. This allows perception of tracks related to radar sensor systems.

subCommands.name: irst_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for IRST tracks. This allows perception of tracks related to IRST and/or other IR sensors used for detection of airborne platforms.

subCommands.name: das_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for DAS (Distributed Aperture System) tracks. This allows perception of tracks related to DAS and/or other multi-aperture IR/EO sensor systems.

subCommands.name: flir_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for FLIR tracks. This allows perception of tracks related to FLIRs and/or other imaging IR sensor systems that are primarily used for detection of surface-based platforms.

subCommands.name: eyes_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for eyes (visual) tracks. This allows perception of tracks related to any aircrew visual (eyes) sightings.

subCommands.name: perception_master_track_processor
subCommands.description: Optional name of a track processor for collecting/coordinating perceived tracks. If this is defined, the specified track processor will be used by the SA Processor when perceiving and assessing tracks. If not specified, the master track processor is used (default).

subCommands.name: flight_id
subCommands.description: Optional flight id (used to denote aircraft in a particular flight). A value of zero indicates that the aircraft is not a member of any flight.

subCommands.name: id_flag
subCommands.description: Optional string that provides an id within a flight.

subCommands.name: bingo_fuel
subCommands.description: Optional bingo fuel level. If not specified, the mover value is used (if available), else zero is used.

subCommands.name: joker_fuel
subCommands.description: Optional joker fuel level. If not specified, the mover value is used (if available), else zero is used.

subCommands.name: reporting_self
subCommands.description: Specifies whether or not to report out asset status messages about this platform.

subCommands.name: reporting_others
subCommands.description: Specifies whether or not to report out messages of all received and known asset status (of other platforms).

subCommands.name: asset_perception
subCommands.description: status_messages: asset perception will utilize any received WsfSA_EntityMessage messages.

subCommands.name: perceive_self
subCommands.description: Include this platform in the list of perceived assets.

subCommands.name: max_threat_load
subCommands.description: Specifies the maximum number of bogie/bandit entities and unfocused groups (i.e. perceived items) that may be perceived.

subCommands.name: max_asset_load
subCommands.description: Specifies the maximum number of assets that may be perceived.

subCommands.name: asset_coast_time
subCommands.description: Specifies the amount of time that asset perceptions should persist after losing a track.

subCommands.name: bandit_coast_time
subCommands.description: Specifies the amount of time that bandit perceptions should persist after losing a track.

subCommands.name: bogey_coast_time
subCommands.description: Specifies the amount of time that bogey perceptions should persist after losing a track.

subCommands.name: use_simple_countermeasures
subCommands.description: If true, the processor will use num_chaff, num_flares, and num_decoys as the initial countermeasure quantities. When WsfSA_Processor.DispenseChaff, WsfSA_Processor.DispenseFlare, and WsfSA_Processor.DispenseDecoy are invoked, these quantities are simply decremented (nothing is physically fired). If false, the processor will model countermeasures using instances of WSF_CHAFF_WEAPON, WSF_FLARE_WEAPON, and WSF_DECOY_WEAPON defined on the parent platform. When WsfSA_Processor.DispenseChaff, WsfSA_Processor.DispenseFlare, and WsfSA_Processor.DispenseDecoy are called, the respective countermeasures are fired.

subCommands.name: num_chaff
subCommands.description: When used together with use_simple_countermeasures, specifies the initial chaff quantity.

subCommands.name: num_flares
subCommands.description: When used together with use_simple_countermeasures, specifies the initial flare quantity.

subCommands.name: num_decoys
subCommands.description: When used together with use_simple_countermeasures, specifies the initial decoy quantity.

subCommands.name: filter_assets_from_bogies
subCommands.description: If true, known assets will automatically be filtered from bogies.

subCommands.name: consideration_score_randomness
subCommands.description: If set, the consideration scores for perceived items will be randomly increased or decreased by an amount less than or equal to this value.

subCommands.name: display_perception_delay
subCommands.description: Specifies the time to wait before recognizing a new non-visual track as a perceived entity that is available for processing and classification.

subCommands.name: visual_perception_delay
subCommands.description: Specifies the time to wait before recognizing a new visual track (i.e. eyes_track_processor) as a perceived entity that is available for processing and classification.

subCommands.name: bogie_threat_score_multiplier
subCommands.description: Multiplier that is used when scoring bogies for the prioritized threat list.

subCommands.name: bogie_target_score_multiplier
subCommands.description: Multiplier that is used when scoring bogies for the prioritized target list.

subCommands.name: ignore_bogies_when_grouping
subCommands.description: If true, bogies will not be considered when forming groups.

subCommands.name: mission_task
subCommands.description: Specifies the primary mission task. This is used in Air Combat Event Pipe data and for display purposes in the Air Combat Visualization Plugin’s Air Combat Overlays.

subCommands.name: max_prioritized_threats
subCommands.description: Specifies limitation to prioritized threat list count.

subCommands.name: max_prioritized_targets
subCommands.description: Specifies limitation to prioritized target list count.

subCommands.name: max_grouping_distance_centroid
subCommands.description: If use_centroid_grouping is true, the maximum distance an entity can be from a group centroid to be considered part of the group.

subCommands.name: max_grouping_distance_neighbor
subCommands.description: If use_neighbor_grouping is true, the maximum distance an entity can be from another entity in a group to be considered part of the same group.

subCommands.name: max_grouping_speed_difference
subCommands.description: If use_speed_grouping is true, the maximum difference in speed an entity can be from a group centroid to be considered part of the group.

subCommands.name: max_grouping_heading_difference
subCommands.description: If use_neighbor_grouping is true, the maximum difference in heading an entity can be from a group centroid to be considered part of the group.

subCommands.name: min_group_radius
subCommands.description: The minimum radius for a group. The group radius is the maximum of the min_group_radius and the largest distance between a group member and the group centroid.

subCommands.name: use_centroid_grouping
subCommands.description: Specifies whether an entity must be within max_grouping_distance_centroid of the group centroid to be considered part of the group.

subCommands.name: use_neighbor_grouping
subCommands.description: Specifies whether an entity must be within max_grouping_distance_neighbor of another entity in a group to be considered part of that group.

subCommands.name: use_speed_grouping
subCommands.description: Specifies whether an entity must be within max_grouping_speed_difference of the group centroid to be considered part of the group. This only applies when entities are considered for joining a group, not for continuing to stay in the group.

subCommands.name: use_heading_grouping
subCommands.description: Specifies whether an entity must be within max_grouping_heading_difference of the group centroid to be considered part of the group. This only applies when entities are considered for joining a group, not for continuing to stay in the group.

subCommands.name: use_type_grouping
subCommands.description: Specifies whether an entity must be the same type as the other members of a group to be considered part of the group. This only applies when entities are considered for joining a group, not for continuing to stay in the group.

subCommands.name: ignore_missiles_as_threats
subCommands.description: Specifies whether perceived missile entities should be ignored when calculating threat values. Typically, perceived missiles are considered threats and are not ignored.

subCommands.name: ignore_bogies_as_threats
subCommands.description: Specifies whether perceived bogie entities should be ignored when calculating threat values. Typically, perceived bogies are considered threats and are not ignored.

subCommands.name: ignore_missiles_as_targets
subCommands.description: Specifies whether perceived missile entities should be ignored when calculating target values. Typically, perceived missiles are not considered targets and are ignored.

subCommands.name: ignore_bogies_as_targets
subCommands.description: Specifies whether perceived bogie entities should be ignored when calculating target values. Typically, perceived bogies are not considered targets and are ignored.

subCommands.name: missile_wez_parameters
subCommands.description: Defines parameters for WEZ calculations. See missile_wez_parameters.

subCommands.name: aircraft_signature_parameters
subCommands.description: Defines parameters for aircraft signatures. See aircraft_signature_parameters.

subCommands.name: AssetConsiderationScoring
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to measure asset importance, which is used to determine how strongly the asset should be considered for maintaining perception. If this function is present, it completely overrides the use of any script functions that try to set asset importance or unimportance. This is only useful when max_asset_load is defined, otherwise no limit will be imposed and importance is not necessary. Values returned by the script may be any value (positive or negative), but assets presenting negative scores will be discarded from consideration. High scores indicate a greater interest in the asset, as compared to others.

subCommands.name: BogieBanditConsiderationScoring
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to measure bogie/bandit importance, which is used to determine how strongly the bogie/bandit should be considered for maintaining perception. If this function is present, it completely overrides the use of any script functions that try to set bogie/bandit importance or unimportance. This is only useful when max_threat_load is defined, otherwise no limit will be imposed and importance is not necessary. Values returned by the script may be any value (positive or negative), but bogies/bandits presenting negative scores will be discarded from consideration. High scores indicate a greater interest in the bogie/bandit, as compared to others.

subCommands.name: MissileConsiderationScoring
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to measure perceived missile bogie/bandit importance, which is used to determine how strongly the missile bogie/bandit should be considered for maintaining perception. If this function is present, it completely overrides the use of any script functions that try to set missile bogie/bandit importance or unimportance. This is only useful when max_threat_load is defined, otherwise no limit will be imposed and importance is not necessary. Values returned by the script may be any value (positive or negative), but missile bogies/bandits presenting negative scores will be discarded from consideration. High scores indicate a greater interest in the missile bogie/bandit, as compared to others.

subCommands.name: UnfocusedGroupConsiderationScoring
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to measure perceived unfocused group importance, which is used to determine how strongly the group should be considered for maintaining perception. If this function is present, it completely overrides the use of any script functions that try to set bogie/bandit importance or unimportance. This is only useful when max_threat_load is defined, otherwise no limit will be imposed and importance is not necessary. Values returned by the script may be any value (positive or negative), but bogies/bandits presenting negative scores will be discarded from consideration. High scores indicate a greater interest in the bogie/bandit, as compared to others.

subCommands.name: CreatePerceivedItemPruningArray
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to override the default behavior to keep the number of perceived items within max_threat_load.

subCommands.name: CalculateRisk
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the overall operational/tactical risk as assessed by the WSF_SA_PROCESSOR. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateSelfRisk
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the operational/tactical “self-risk” as assessed by the WSF_SA_PROCESSOR, considering only the risk faced by this platform. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateFlightRisk
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the operational/tactical “flight risk” as assessed by the WSF_SA_PROCESSOR, considering the risk that the flight of aircraft (often two or four aircraft) is facing. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculatePackageRisk
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the operational/tactical “package risk” as assessed by the WSF_SA_PROCESSOR, considering the risk that the package of aircraft (often multiple flights of aircraft) is facing. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateMissionRisk
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the operational/tactical “mission risk” as assessed by the WSF_SA_PROCESSOR, considering the risk(s) that might prevent the success of the current mission. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateDefensiveness
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the degree of defensiveness that the platform has assessed for the current operational/tactical situation as assessed by the WSF_SA_PROCESSOR. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateUrgency
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the sense of urgency imposed by the operational/tactical situation as assessed by the WSF_SA_PROCESSOR. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateWeaponSupport
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate if a weapon is being supported (i.e., is being provided track update information by the parent platform). If a weapon is being supported, it should return true. There is no default implementation for weapon support, so if this function is omitted, the weapon support condition will always be false.

subCommands.name: CalculateThreatLevel
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the threat level presented by the specified bogie/bandit (aThreat). The boolean (aIsBogie) should be true if the threat is a bogie and false if the threat is a bandit. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateMissileThreatLevel
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the threat level presented by the specified missile bogie/bandit (aThreat). The boolean (aIsBogie) should be true if the threat is a bogie and false if the threat is a bandit. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation. This is used with CalculateThreatLevel, where CalculateMissileThreatLevel is used for perceived missiles, while CalculateThreatLevel is used for aircraft (and even missiles that are not yet perceived as missiles).

subCommands.name: CalculateGroupThreatLevel
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the threat level presented by the specified unfocused group of bogies/bandits (aThreat). The boolean (aIsBogie) should be true if the threat is a bogie and false if the threat is a bandit. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation. This is used with CalculateThreatLevel, where CalculateGroupThreatLevel is used for perceived unfocused groups, while CalculateThreatLevel is used for aircraft (and even missiles that are not yet perceived as missiles).

subCommands.name: CalculateTargetValue
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the target value offered by the specified bogie/bandit (aTarget). The boolean (aIsBogie) should be true if the target is a bogie and false if the target is a bandit. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateMissileTargetValue
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the target value offered by the specified missile bogie/bandit (aTarget). The boolean (aIsBogie) should be true if the target is a bogie and false if the target is a bandit. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation. This is used with CalculateTargetValue, where CalculateMissileTargetValue is used for perceived missiles, while CalculateTargetValue is used for aircraft (and even missiles that are not yet perceived as missiles).

subCommands.name: CalculateGroupTargetValue
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the target value offered by the specified unfocused group of bogies/bandits (aTarget). The boolean (aIsBogie) should be true if the target is a bogie and false if the target is a bandit. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation. This is used with CalculateTargetValue, where CalculateGroupTargetValue is used for unfocused groups, while CalculateTargetValue is used for aircraft (and even missiles that are not yet perceived as missiles).

subCommands.name: CalculateRiskPosedByEntity
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the risk posed by the specified bogie/bandit entity. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateDefensivenessInducedByEntity
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the degree of defensiveness induced by the specified bogie/bandit entity. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: CalculateUrgencyInducedByEntity
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to calculate the sense of urgency induced by the specified bogie/bandit entity. This should return a normalized value between 0.0 and 1.0. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionInTime
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionForward
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming forward motion. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionLevelTurnLeft
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming it carries out a constant-g turn to its left. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionLevelTurnRight
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming it carries out a g-limited level turn to its right. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionTurnToHeading
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming it carries out a g-limited level turn to the provided heading. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionGoToPoint
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming it carries out a g-limited level turn toward the provided location. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionSlice
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming it carries out a g-limited roll-and-pull maneuver away from its current heading. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionSliceToHeading
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming it carries out a g-limited roll-and-pull maneuver to the provided heading. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This optional script will override the default calculation.

subCommands.name: ProjectPositionSplitS
subCommands.description: This is an optional script used to estimate a future location for an entity, assuming it carries out a g-limited split-S maneuver. This should return a valid WsfGeoPoint. This optional script will override the default calculation.

name: WSF_SAM_LAUNCH_COMPUTER
description: Provides a listing of the lateral offsets used as the first independent variable (slowest-changing index) in the intercept_envelope which follows. Lateral offset is the horizontal distance with which the target would overfly the launcher if the current track is maintained. Values are to be provided in increasing order, and the effect is assumed symmetrical about the launcher’s line-of-sight axis.

subCommands.name: lateral_offsets
subCommands.description: Provides a listing of the lateral offsets used as the first independent variable (slowest-changing index) in the intercept_envelope which follows. Lateral offset is the horizontal distance with which the target would overfly the launcher if the current track is maintained. Values are to be provided in increasing order, and the effect is assumed symmetrical about the launcher’s line-of-sight axis.

subCommands.name: altitudes
subCommands.description: Specifies the target altitudes used as the second independent variable in the intercept_envelope below. May be uneven but must be in increasing numerical order.

subCommands.name: ranges
subCommands.description: Specifies the ground ranges used as the third independent variable in the intercept_envelope. May be uneven but must be in increasing numerical order.

subCommands.name: speeds
subCommands.description: Specifies the target speeds used as the fourth independent variable in the intercept_envelope. May be uneven but must be in increasing numerical order.

subCommands.name: intercept_envelope
subCommands.description: This block contains the data that defines the intercept envelope. By convention, any unsuccessful intercept point may be omitted from the tabulation, and a time-of-flight of -1.0 seconds (a miss) is assumed. The five index values given in the example below are printed out by the class weapon_tools generator, and are used to assure proper indexing when the data is read in by the stream parser.

subCommands.name: interpolation_test
subCommands.description: For debug purposes only, and optional. Inside this block one may place one or more ‘lateral_offset <distance-value>’, ‘altitude <distance-value>’, ‘target_speed <speed_value>’ and ‘ground_range <distance_value>’ specifications. Each time the keyword ‘test’ appears, the most recent value of (offset, altitude, speed, range) is saved off as a test point, and stored into a test point array. After the launch computer is initialized, each of these test points will be evaluated, and the corresponding interpolated time-of-flight value will be printed to the screen. The example given below saves off three points for testing.

Lateral offset is the horizontal distance with which the target would overfly the launcher if the current track is maintained. Values are to be provided in increasing order, and the effect is assumed symmetrical about the launcher’s line-of-sight axis.

subCommands.name: altitudes

subCommands.name: ranges

subCommands.name: speeds

name: WSF_SAR_SENSOR
description: Specifies the range used to map signal strength to normalized pixel intensity in the resulting image. A signal strength less than <min-db-power> will have a pixel intensity of zero, while a signal strength greater than <max-db-power> will have a pixel intensity of one.

subCommands.name: intensity_limits
subCommands.description: Specifies the range used to map signal strength to normalized pixel intensity in the resulting image. A signal strength less than <min-db-power> will have a pixel intensity of zero, while a signal strength greater than <max-db-power> will have a pixel intensity of one.

subCommands.name: intensity_range
subCommands.description: Specifies the range used to map signal strength to a normalized pixel intensity. A signal strength less than noise_power will have a pixel intensity of zero, while a signal strength greater than receiver noise power plus the value of this command will have a pixel intensity of one.

subCommands.name: rescale_substandard_image
subCommands.description: For ‘spot’ mode only. Specifies if a ‘substandard image’ should be rescaled so its aspect ratio of the pixels is the same as a ‘standard image.’ A ‘substandard image’ is one where the the collection time was insufficient to produce the desired cross range resolution (as defined by resolution command or derived from the dwell_time command.

subCommands.name: show_calibration_data
subCommands.description: If specified, the model will display general sensor performance data (e.g., power, frequency, antenna gains) when the sensor is created.

subCommands.name: show_status
subCommands.description: If specified, the model will display certain key calculated parameters whenever the sensor changes state (turned on or off or mode changed).

subCommands.name: call_sensor_track_observers
subCommands.description: Specify if the ‘sensor track observers’ should be called. If true, sensor track observer events will be invoked which enables the generation of data that allows many visualization tools to display detection lines during the image formation process. These extra events, however, may cause problems to some observers if they haven’t been modified to ignore these events (which is the reason for the default being ‘false’).

subCommands.name: sar_constraint_plotting
subCommands.description: If ‘true’, the model will internally remove certain internal limits to allow a ‘SAR Constraint plot’ to be properly created within using the horizontal_map function of sensor_plot.

subCommands.name: operating_mode
subCommands.description: Specifies the operating mode. In ‘spot’ mode, when the sensor is turned on, it will be trained on the current cued location and an ‘image will be formed. The image will be delivered when the sensor is subsequently turned off, either as a result of automatic_turn_off or by an explicit external request (WsfSensor.TurnOff).

subCommands.name: automatic_turn_off
subCommands.description: For ‘spot’ mode only. If specified the sensor will automatically turn itself off after the dwell_time or by the time required to form an image whose resolution is at least that specified by resolution.

subCommands.name: resolution
subCommands.description: Specifies the desired cross range resolution of an image cell/pixel. This is used to compute the dwell time necessary form a image of the specified cross range resolution.

subCommands.name: dwell_time
subCommands.description: Specifies the ‘collection time,’ or the amount of time the sensor will dwell on the location in order to form the image. This is also used to predict cross range resolution.

subCommands.name: maximum_dwell_time
subCommands.description: For ‘spot’ mode only. If specified, the dwell time computed to achieve the desired resolution will be limited to this value.

subCommands.name: maximum_detectable_speed
subCommands.description: Specifies the maximum possible speed at which an object can be traveling and still be present in the image.

subCommands.name: minimum_clutter_to_noise_ratio
subCommands.description: For ‘spot’ mode only. Specifies the clutter-to-noise ratio below, which the image will be declared to be ‘substandard.’ See inhibit_substandard_collection for more information.

subCommands.name: inhibit_substandard_collection
subCommands.description: For ‘spot’ mode only. If true, the request to collect an image will be suppressed if the internally computed clutter-to-noise ratio for the desired resolution is below the minimum_clutter_to_noise_ratio. subCommands.name: doppler_overcollect_ratio
subCommands.description: A ‘safety margin’ to be used when computing the minimum PRF that is allowed. This is typically in the range of [ 1.0, 2.0 ].

subCommands.name: image_height
subCommands.description: Specify the width and height respectively of SAR image area as measured on the ground. subCommands.name: image_size
subCommands.description: An alternative means of specify the height and width of SAR image area as measured on the ground. This is the same as specifying the same value for image_width and image_height.

subCommands.name: sar_error_model_parameters
subCommands.description: This command will invoke the range and Doppler error computation and application to generate SAR Target Location Errors. This involved translating SUPPRESSOR’s mtsar.f routine, which was merely a translation from TRIMSIM. This generates a Range and Doppler variance that was then used in an error application routine coded from equations to compute SAR Target Location Errors (TLEs). The new input data is as follows, and if used will supersede the baseline error computation method.

name: WSF_SIX_DOF_FUEL
description: Defines the initial quantity of fuel to be loaded on the vehicle. WSF_SIX_DOF_FUEL will interact with WSF_SIX_DOF_MOVER to set the initial fuel. Fuel will be added to internal tanks first, keeping the percentage filled for each tank in sync. For example, if the initial_quantity was 75% of the total internal fuel capacity, each internal fuel tank would be filled to 75% and no external tanks would be filled.

subCommands.description: WSF_SIX_DOF_FUEL and WSF_SIX_DOF_MOVER do not use a fuel mode. If mode is specified, it will be ignored and WSF_SIX_DOF_FUEL will output a warning.
